body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. However, I have some concerns about shader compatibility across platforms and GPUs:

On my RTX 5090 on Linux + Vulkan, the limits for the texture offset appear to be `-8; 7` and `-32; 31` for texture gather offset. The limit for texture offset is the same in OpenGL.

The texture gather limit is lower on Metal (hardcoded to `-8; 7`), which is going to cause compatibility issues for shaders that rely on higher/lower values than that.
